verifications.claim: NASA successfully launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis II crew blasted off on their lunar journey from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Wednesday... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time.' (dated 2026/04/01); R2: 'lifted off... at 6:35 p.m. EDT'; R5: 'Artemis II (April 1, 2026)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the successful launch on April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center.

verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state four astronauts on a ~10-day mission around the Moon.
